## File: berriai_litellm/litellm/llms/minimax/messages/transformation.py

Prompts

```
['create a MinimaxMessagesConfig instance to configure MiniMax Anthropic-compatible API access', 'get the MiniMax API key from environment variable or parameter fallback chain', 'get the MiniMax API base URL with international or China endpoint fallback', 'build the complete MiniMax API URL by appending the v1/messages endpoint to a base URL', "retrieve the custom LLM provider string 'minimax' from MinimaxMessagesConfig"]
```

```
{'create_minimax_config': 'create a MinimaxMessagesConfig instance to configure MiniMax Anthropic-compatible API access', 'get_minimax_api_key': 'get the MiniMax API key from environment variable or parameter fallback chain', 'get_minimax_api_base': 'get the MiniMax API base URL with international or China endpoint fallback', 'build_minimax_complete_url': 'build the complete MiniMax API URL by appending the v1/messages endpoint to a base URL', 'retrieve_minimax_provider': "retrieve the custom LLM provider string 'minimax' from MinimaxMessagesConfig"}
```
